{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Sacrifice (Swedish: Offret ) is a 1986 Swedish film directed by Andrei Tarkovsky.","title":"The Sacrifice"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Starring Erland Josephson, it centers on a middle-aged intellectual who attempts to bargain with God to stop an impending nuclear holocaust.","title":"The Sacrifice"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" \"The Sacrifice\" was Tarkovsky's third film as a Soviet expatriate, after \"Nostalghia\" and the documentary \"Voyage in Time\", and was also his last, as he died shortly after its completion.","title":"The Sacrifice"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Like 1972's \"Solaris\", it won the Grand Prix at the Cannes Film Festival.","title":"The Sacrifice"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"One Day in the Life of Andrei Arsenevich (French: Une journée d'Andrei Arsenevitch ) is a 1999 French documentary film directed by Chris Marker, about and an homage to the Russian filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky.","title":"One Day in the Life of Andrei Arsenevich"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The film was an episode of the French documentary film series \"Cinéastes de notre temps\" (English: \"Filmmakers of our time\" ), which in over ninety episodes since 1966 concentrates on individual film directors, film people and film movements.","title":"One Day in the Life of Andrei Arsenevich"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The title of the film is a play on the title of Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn's novella \"One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich\".","title":"One Day in the Life of Andrei Arsenevich"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"1986","question":"What year did Andrei Tarkovsky make the film whose making is documented in Voyage in Time?"}
